title: Walt Disney's MultiPlane Camera (Filmed: Feb. 13, 1957)
summary: A 1957 Walt Disney film in which he explains and demonstrates the multiplane camera, the animation tool that gave 2D films depth. It is a short behind-the-scenes piece from Disney's archives.
why: Recommended as a charming primary source on animation technique and for Walt Disney's warm on-camera presence.

quote.text: Here's a fascinating video in which Walt Disney showcases how his multiplane camera worked
